name: Spring Boot
description: A Java Spring Boot REST API with Bean Validation, ProblemDetail errors and springdoc-openapi.

specSections.title: API Contract & Error Codes
specSections.guidance: List every endpoint under /api with its method, route, operation ID (the @Operation operationId, which becomes the client method name), request and response DTO records, the security rule (@PreAuthorize role plus ownership check) and the status codes it returns. Give the error table: each UPPER_SNAKE errorCode, its HTTP status and when it applies; errors are RFC 9457 ProblemDetail with an errorCode property, validation errors are 400 with an errors map, and optimistic-lock failures are 409 CONFLICT. Name the auth scheme (session cookies with CSRF for same-origin, OAuth2 resource server JWT for cross-origin) and the Actuator probes /api/health/liveness and /api/health/readiness.

order.reason: Change the contract (backend/openapi/api.json) before regenerating the frontend client from it.

generatedFiles.ciCheck: cd {be} && mvn -B -Dtest=OpenApiExportIT test && git diff --exit-code openapi/api.json

requiredEnv.description: The platform database URI (postgres://…), converted at startup by an EnvironmentPostProcessor into SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL, _USERNAME and _PASSWORD.
Comma-separated frontend origins the CORS configuration allows (cross-origin model only).

checklist.item: Domain logic is testable without Spring and unit-tested by FR; controllers are thin and services orchestrate.
DTOs are validated records (Bean Validation, @Valid), never entities.
Errors are RFC 9457 ProblemDetail carrying the spec's errorCode, with 400 validation maps and 409 CONFLICT on optimistic-lock failures.
The SecurityFilterChain matches the origin model, protected operations have @PreAuthorize plus ownership checks, and CORS is only enabled for cross-origin with explicit origins.
DATABASE_URL conversion is handled, config is typed @ConfigurationProperties with @Validated, and no secrets are in YAML.
Integration tests (Testcontainers, @ServiceConnection) cover success, 400, 401, 403, 404, each errorCode and 409.
Operation IDs are stable, openapi/api.json matches the export (CI freshness check), and the gate passes.

gate: cd {be} && mvn -B -Dtest=OpenApiExportIT test && git diff --exit-code openapi/api.json
